author: ojiudezue
title: Door direction scoring: no instrument passes; build the count route and record-only vision direction
summary: Arc row 6 scored every door-direction instrument once on the operator's 27 grades (19 directional). No instrument clears the plan's direction bar. P3-D2 (crossing-centred frames, 8 frames) passes its own gate and is being built; P3-D3 (watch every crossing incl. ambiguous) is built record-only behind INV-DIR-GATE; the approach-clip LLM montage (P3-D0e R-c) is NO-GO at 13/15; P3-D11's direction part fails the P3-D6 bar.
why: The production tracker was 10/19 with all 9 misses entry-called-exit, a one-sided bias; the best deterministic variant (I4 interior timing, 17/19) was picked from ~6 variants on the same clips with no holdout and beats always-'in' (15/19) by only 2, so promoting it would be fitting noise. Vision counts are already good (16/17 exact) and the recording route passed its gate, so the count path ships now while direction keeps accumulating graded reps (operator 11-15: 'build and hold off and measure. We need reps').
alternatives_considered: Promote I4 interior timing into the tracker now (rejected: no holdout, margin of 2 over the trivial baseline)
Build P3-D10 approach clips on R-c (rejected: 87% vs 88% bar, only 4 'out' grades, stability n=14 < 20)
Park direction work until more grades (rejected: P3-D3 recording is what produces the reps)
implications: Direction stays the tracker's (biased) call for every reader until P3-D6 shows a Wilson lower bound >= 0.90 on >= 30 scored crossings per door; the front door has 1 'out' grade, so the grading run must deliberately collect exits. Arrival naming (step 7) inherits the entry->exit bias until then.
revisit_trigger: 30+ graded crossings per door including >= 8 exits, or R-a/R-b approach routes pass before the clips expire 2026-11-19
